title: Grounding Spatial Representations via Visual World Models for Robust Autoregressive Drift Reduction in Low-Power Robot Telemetry: Code and Data Artifacts
description: Complete research software and data artifacts for the V-JEPA Grounded Spatial Representation framework. Eliminates autoregressive drift in closed-loop robotic action forecasting by regularizing lightweight (2.46M parameter) student sequence models against pre-trained V-JEPA visual world model latent manifolds during training. Evaluated in complete Visual Silence across 21 held-out test episodes in closed-loop MuJoCo physics simulation, achieving a 73.80% reduction in spatial trajectory drift.
